breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the uniform load by its single resultant for an exact deflection calculation, but equivalent resultants preserve force and moment, not the full beam-deflection response.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the incorrect approach from the incomplete prompt — replacing the uniform distributed load with its resultant force P = wL = 2000 N applied at midspan (x = L/2). This is exactly the inconsistency that should have been removed. The ground truth prompt simply asks for the exact deflection and slope using the actual uniform distributed load formulas (δ = wL⁴/8EI and θ = wL³/6EI), without any resultant substitution. The agent failed to fix this error and instead produced results based on the flawed point-load-at-midspan approximation.
